topic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
source_evidence: Having a “long” position in a security means that you own the security. The opposite of a “long” position is a “short” position.
answer: A long stock position means you own the stock; investors may hold it expecting its value to rise. A short position generally means selling stock you do not own, often after borrowing it. A short seller typically hopes the price will fall, then buys the stock later to return it to the lender. If the price instead rises before they buy it back, they incur a loss.
